# HTML Library

> 191 copy-paste UI components written in plain HTML + Tailwind CSS.
> No React, no JavaScript, no dependencies. Every component is a self-contained
> fragment that works anywhere Tailwind runs.

Fetch any component with `curl -s https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/<name>.json | jq -r '.files[0].content'`.

## Agent skill

- [Full skill (single file)](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/skill.md): everything below plus the
  class-portability contract, CSS-only interactivity patterns and composition recipes.
- [Registry index](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/index.json): machine-readable list of every component.
- [Item schema](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/schema.json)

## Apps (6)

- [app-onboarding](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-onboarding.json): A welcome screen with a gradient hero, paging dots, primary and social sign-in actions, and iOS status bar chrome.
- [app-feed](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-feed.json): A discovery feed: category chips, a featured card with a real photo, compact list rows with author avatars, and a four-item tab bar.
- [app-wallet](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-wallet.json): A finance home: dark balance card with trend pill, a row of quick actions, and a categorised transaction list.
- [app-checkout](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-checkout.json): An order review screen: line items with quantity steppers, delivery address, selectable payment methods, totals, and a sticky pay bar.
- [app-chat-inbox](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-chat-inbox.json): A messages list: search field, pinned avatars with presence, unread and read-receipt states, and a tab bar.
- [app-profile-settings](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/app-profile-settings.json): An account screen: avatar header with membership badge and stat row, plus grouped setting rows with toggles, values and a destructive action.

## Sites (29)

- [site-landing](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-landing.json): A marketing home: nav bar, announcement pill, large hero with dual calls to action, logo social proof, and a three-column feature row.
- [site-pricing](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-pricing.json): Three pricing tiers with a monthly/yearly toggle, a highlighted popular plan, checked feature lists, and an FAQ strip.
- [site-dashboard](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-dashboard.json): A product app shell: navigation sidebar with account footer, stat tiles with trends, a bar chart with range toggle, and a status table.
- [site-docs](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-docs.json): A three-column docs layout: search bar with shortcut, grouped nav, article with breadcrumb, code block, callout and options table, plus an on-this-page rail.
- [site-auth](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-auth.json): A split authentication page: social and credential sign-in with remember-me on one side, a dark testimonial panel with stats on the other.
- [site-agents](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-agents.json): A warm-toned product landing page: sticky nav with dropdown affordances, breadcrumb strip, split hero with a node-graph illustration, and a partner logo wall.
- [site-research](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-research.json): A publication home page: translucent nav, centred prompt hero with quick-action pills, a bento lead story and a recent-news row. Thumbnails are real photos.
- [site-fintech-hero](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-fintech-hero.json): A full-bleed photo backdrop with a floating pill nav and a footer-anchored headline — the composition that pairs a bold claim with feature chips below the fold.
- [section-hero](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-hero.json): A centred marketing hero: announcement pill, large headline, supporting copy, dual calls to action, and avatar social proof.
- [section-features](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-features.json): A six-item feature grid with icon tiles, an eyebrow label and a centred section heading.
- [section-bento](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-bento.json): A mixed-size feature grid: one large panel with a bar chart, three supporting tiles, and a wide closing tile.
- [section-pricing](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-pricing.json): Three pricing tiers with a working monthly/yearly toggle that swaps the price, a highlighted popular plan, and checked feature lists.
- [section-testimonials](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-testimonials.json): A working quote slider: three testimonials switched by clickable dot navigation, no JavaScript.
- [section-faq](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-faq.json): A five-question accordion built on native details/summary, with a rotating plus icon and a contact line.
- [section-cta](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-cta.json): A dark closing call-to-action banner with decorative gradients and dual actions.
- [section-stats](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-stats.json): A four-up metric row on a dark band, with a heading and supporting line.
- [section-logo-cloud](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-logo-cloud.json): A compact social-proof band: an eyebrow label above a row of muted customer wordmarks.
- [section-team](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-team.json): A four-up team grid: photo avatar, name and role, with a heading and supporting line above.
- [section-newsletter](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-newsletter.json): A real email subscribe form with native required validation, an icon tile and a supporting line.
- [site-component-docs](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-component-docs.json): A design-system component reference: category nav tree, live stage preview, best-practices table, examples, and an on-this-page rail.
- [section-footer](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-footer.json): A five-column footer: brand blurb, four link groups, and a legal row with social icons.
- [site-storefront](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-storefront.json): An ecommerce top nav with a hover mega menu, hero banner and category grid rows.
- [section-customer-stories](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-customer-stories.json): A two-column case-study grid pairing a square brand-locked thumbnail with a headline, summary and inline link. Thumbnails are real photos.
- [site-product-gallery](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-product-gallery.json): A marketing header over a grid of square product cards with pricing.
- [section-plan-picker](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-plan-picker.json): Credit-based pricing tiers with a per-month allowance box, indented model lists, and a highlighted plan wrapped in a dark shell with an amber call to action.
- [site-ide-shell](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-ide-shell.json): A code-editor shell: menu bar, file-tree sidebar with an active file, editor tabs and a mock code area.
- [section-service-grid](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-service-grid.json): A 2×2 directory of service categories, each a pastel panel with tag pills and an Explore footer, above a filter header with a live status dot.
- [site-setup-guide](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/site-setup-guide.json): A getting-started documentation page: an AI assistance prompt card, prerequisites, install steps with code blocks, and an on-this-page rail.
- [section-lead-form](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/section-lead-form.json): A long-form informational page — savings, benefits and contractor copy — ending in a multi-fieldset request form with a real radio-scale question. Auto-height, so nothing is clipped.

## Agent Elements (23)

- [agent-chat](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/agent-chat.json): A complete conversation shell: header with agent status, scrollable thread with an inline tool call, and a composer.
- [message-list](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/message-list.json): A conversation thread with user bubbles, assistant turns, hover actions, and a streaming turn with a caret.
- [input-bar](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/input-bar.json): The composer: auto-height textarea, attachment and tools controls, model readout, dictation, and a send button.
- [suggestions](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/suggestions.json): Prompt starters in two shapes: a wrapping chip row and a stacked list with icons and descriptions.
- [model-picker](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/model-picker.json): A model selector trigger plus the open menu: options with descriptions, a selected check, and a settings row.
- [mode-selector](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/mode-selector.json): Segmented controls for switching agent modes — a full-width pill group and a compact bordered variant.
- [user-message](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/user-message.json): The sent turn: a plain bubble and a richer variant with an attached file, timestamp, and edit/copy actions.
- [markdown](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/markdown.json): Typography for rendered agent output: headings, lists, inline code, a titled code block, blockquote, table, and links.
- [send-button](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/send-button.json): Send affordance in four states: idle, disabled, generating (stop), and a labelled variant with a keyboard hint.
- [attachment-button](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/attachment-button.json): Attachment triggers (plus and paperclip) with the open source menu: file, image, repo, and clipboard.
- [file-attachment](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/file-attachment.json): Attached files as removable chips, an uploading card with a progress bar, and a failed card with a retry action.
- [text-shimmer](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/text-shimmer.json): A shimmering status label for pending work, plus a pulsing skeleton. Ships one scoped style block for the keyframes.
- [spiral-loader](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/spiral-loader.json): A masked conic-gradient spinner in three sizes, a bordered ring variant, and an inline running-status row.
- [bash-tool](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/bash-tool.json): Terminal tool calls: command header, scrollable output, exit-status pill, duration footer, and a failed variant.
- [edit-tool](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/edit-tool.json): A file-edit tool call rendered as a diff: path header with +/− counts, gutter line numbers, and apply actions.
- [search-tool](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/search-tool.json): Grep-style results grouped by file, with line gutters, highlighted matches, and a search summary footer.
- [todo-tool](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/todo-tool.json): The agent's task list: completed items struck through, an in-progress row with a spinner, pending rows, and a progress bar.
- [plan-tool](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/plan-tool.json): A proposed plan awaiting approval: numbered steps with affected files, a status pill, and approve/edit actions.
- [tool-group](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/tool-group.json): A collapsible run of tool calls: summary header with stacked icons and timing, collapsed, expanded, and running children.
- [ide-composer](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/ide-composer.json): A dark, IDE-embedded prompt bar: session placeholder with a blinking caret, mode toggle row, and a bottom Local/Remote action strip. Always dark, like the editor panel it depicts.
- [chat-landing](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/chat-landing.json): A full-page AI assistant home: greeting, rich composer, category toggles and filtered suggestion cards.
- [chat-welcome](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/chat-welcome.json): The empty-state screen before any messages exist: a centred greeting above a rounded composer with a teal send button and a scroll-to-bottom affordance.
- [chat-conversation](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/chat-conversation.json): A full-page thread with a user message, an expanded tool-call log, a rendered code block, and a split artifact document panel.

## UI Elements (23)

- [button](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/button.json): Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and link buttons across four sizes, with loading, disabled and icon states.
- [badge](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/badge.json): Status pills in seven tones plus dot, counter, removable-tag and small label variants.
- [card](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/card.json): A surface in three shapes: header/body/footer card, stat card with a bar sparkline, and a clickable link card.
- [input](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/input.json): Form fields: labelled input with hint, search with shortcut, prefixed input, invalid state, textarea and disabled.
- [alert](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/alert.json): Neutral, success, warning and error alerts with icons and actions, plus a solid inline announcement banner.
- [tabs](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/tabs.json): Three tab patterns — underline with a count badge, pill group, and vertical tabs beside a panel.
- [avatar](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/avatar.json): Photo avatars in four sizes and several tones, with a presence dot, initials and icon fallback states, overlap stack and account row.
- [empty-state](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/empty-state.json): A dashed placeholder with icon, copy and actions, plus a compact no-results row for search.
- [radio-card-group](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/radio-card-group.json): Selectable plan cards backed by native radio inputs — checked, hover and disabled states are driven entirely by CSS, so selection works without JavaScript.
- [prompt-composer](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/prompt-composer.json): A rounded message box with an inline toolbar — attachment, agent and model pickers on the left, send on the right. The shell lights up on focus-within.
- [auth-card](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/auth-card.json): A sign-in panel with crosshair corner marks and bleeding hairlines — email and password fields, a primary action, and GitHub / Google providers.
- [badge-pill](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/badge-pill.json): shadcn-style semantic badge variants — default, secondary, outline and destructive — for labelling status inside a larger component.
- [login-glass](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/login-glass.json): A translucent, glassmorphic auth card floating over two soft drifting blobs — email, password and a full-width primary action.
- [nav-horizontal](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/nav-horizontal.json): A top tab strip with a sliding underline indicator, working via a radio group and CSS — no JavaScript.
- [nav-vertical](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/nav-vertical.json): A sidebar navigation list with a selected-state highlight, paired with a content pane.
- [skeleton-card](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/skeleton-card.json): A pulsing placeholder for a card — avatar, image, text lines and action buttons — shown while real content loads.
- [skeleton-list](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/skeleton-list.json): Staggered pulsing rows for a loading data list — avatar, two text lines and a status pill per row.
- [spinner](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/spinner.json): A spinning ring loading indicator in four sizes.
- [spinner-overlay](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/spinner-overlay.json): A blocking loading overlay with a spinner and label over blurred underlying content.
- [switch](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/switch.json): A real toggle switch in on, off and disabled states, driven entirely by a hidden checkbox and CSS.
- [switch-list](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/switch-list.json): Labeled toggle rows for a settings panel, including a disabled row managed by an admin.
- [table](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/table.json): A simple data table with a header, hover rows and a title/description block.
- [table-interactive](https://xnsteam-ai.github.io/Html-library/r/table-interactive.json): A selectable data table where checking a row reveals a bulk-actions bar, driven purely by CSS `:has()`.
